comment: Pursuits as DATA (src/spaces.mjs). A pursuit is any network membership record; its items are only what members put there. share_from_private names, for each kind of record in a person's private Trillion, the fields a share copies into a space: a kind not named here cannot be shared from private, and a field not named here never leaves the private store (a decision keeps the pursuits it was weighed against, which are left behind). title is the path to the field a shared copy is titled by. max_item_bytes caps one item's copied body. page is how many items one read returns at most. invites: an invite link lasts default_days unless its maker names days (at most max_days); join_address is where the link opens (the invite's own page, src/invite-routes.mjs, drawn from src/space-invitation.json; signed in, joining lands in the pursuit) and the query parameter that carries its code, which the Pursuits screen reads too. colours are the colours a member may give a pursuit (shown on its card and beside its title, and chosen from its menu): each `id` is a hue of the shared screen-look palette (parts/screen-look/show/coss-workspace.css `--record-kind-<id>`), so it reads right in every look, and `label` is the word a person picks it by. A pursuit with no colour shows as before; a colour not named here is refused. made_by_trillion is how a thing Trillion itself placed in a pursuit (origin trillion, such as a step it gives a member) reads: who it is by and where it came from, never the member it was placed for.

search._what: read_space with a query (src/spaces.mjs spaceItems): the words are matched against each item as the asker sees it (a hidden thing's words only for a reader who may show it again), never against the stored copy alone, so a search never finds words its reader could not read. `terms_most`: how many words are used (all must be in the item); `term_chars_most`: the longest word; `scan_batches`: how many pages of candidates one call walks to fill a page, after which it answers what it has with next_before so the caller goes on.

named.comment: A pursuit may be named by its name instead of its id wherever an AI names a pursuit (src/space-names.mjs): the one pursuit of the person's whose name is the words given (any case), else the one whose name holds them. These are the words when none or several are.
named.none: None of your pursuits is named "{name}". Your spaces: {spaces}.
named.several: More than one of your pursuits is named "{name}"; use its space_id. They are: {spaces}.
